title: Respiration (get_respiration_data)
description:
Returned by garminconnect's get_respiration_data(date). Consumed by sync_respiration.

Verified against: 2026-07-28, 2026-07-15, 2026-08-05, 2026-08-06. Additional fields beyond what's listed here may exist and are tolerated (additionalProperties: true) — Garmin adding new fields is not a breaking change; a listed field disappearing or changing type is.

2026-08-05 (via automatic drift-check on live data, #68): avgTomorrowSleepRespirationValue and the four tomorrowSleep*Timestamp* fields observed null (no next-day sleep prediction yet available) — now nullable rather than required-present. respirationAveragesValuesArray's inner values observed as floats (e.g. 14.11), not integers, and null-padded in the day's last row — widened to integer|number|null. None of these fields are consumed by sync_respiration (only lowest/highest/avgWaking/avgSleepRespirationValue are), so this was schema over-strictness, not a real API change.

2026-08-06: this time the *entire* response (avgSleepRespirationValue, avgWakingRespirationValue, all four start/endTimestamp fields, both value-descriptor lists, both values arrays) observed null right after day rollover, before Garmin had computed anything for the new day yet — the same not-computed-yet pattern as 2026-08-05, just earlier in the pipeline and covering every remaining field instead of just the tomorrow-prediction ones.
